prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create exactly ONE single animation frame, one character only, not a sprite sheet. Existing game pet Chishakui / 赤砂魁. Input 1 is the PRIMARY identity and E front three-quarter orientation. Input 2 is supporting rear identity and backpack material ONLY; do not change to rear view or copy its hand assignment. Input 3 is the MAIN painting/material style reference, not a UI to reproduce. Preserve exact warm terracotta cloud-pattern lion cub guardian, rounded gold-brown eyes, cream face clouds, curled clay ears and mane, small indigo ivory gold jade crown, indigo/ivory silk robes, fine gold ornaments, jade waist ring, ivory tassels, closed porcelain kiln backpack strapped centrally to the back. Two arms, two legs, two boots; no wings, no visible tail, no extra limbs. Anatomical RIGHT hand is near-side at SCREEN LEFT and holds the single short jade hammer tightly for the ENTIRE animation, never swap hands or let go. Anatomical LEFT palm is empty at SCREEN RIGHT, used for casting. Fixed orthographic three-quarter FRONT view facing lower-right; face and chest visible throughout, no camera rotation. Stationary animation, stable planted feet aligned with knees, never turn soles outward. Frame canvas exactly square 1024x1024 true transparent RGBA, no ground or shadow plate, no text/UI/watermark. Consistent character scale: crown around y140, soles around y942, ground pivot [512,942]; full hammer, crown, sleeves and backpack within frame. Clean bright rounded high-resolution Taoist chibi hand-painted finish matching references, warm subtle illumination, crisp transparent silhouette. Do not redesign or simplify ornament/material. Generate requested pose genuinely, do not translate or mirror existing image.
Frame 01 of 16, 45ms: neutral casting preparation. Torso upright with both knees softly bent and both boots planted. Right hand screen-left grips hammer beside hip with head diagonally down toward center. Empty left hand screen-right relaxed near waist, palm slightly forward. No magic yet.
